## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with all four margins called positive [F7] despite severity-3 blur.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% [F1] | Near-certain invasive score; test ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 10%) | Single class at 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 90th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Passes QC despite severity-3 blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (80%–87% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match; InSitu 77% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.81) pushes toward invasive; 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-1.14) pushes toward invasive; 20/20 AI spot check [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.77), but 0/20 spot check and weak concept [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Elevated infiltration score (+1.20) pushes toward invasive; 19/20 spot check · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low tubule score (-0.65, caption-inconsistent) pushes toward invasive; 18/20 spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (3-region deletion drop +0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197), though all 12 regions score 1.0.
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Contrast case BACH_0253 is InSitu (77% similarity), differing most in benign stroma/fat and duct confinement (region 6).
- Simulated frozen-section blur (severity 3, 90th OOD percentile) obscures duct borders; cell segmentation is disabled and stains blocked.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 5, 9**: Confirm true stromal infiltration rather than severity-3 blur artifact; ignore Unreliable mitotic scores.
2. **Regions 6, 7, 8**: Assess duct confinement and residual benign stroma to exclude InSitu (contrast case BACH_0253).
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Verify tumor at superior, inferior, medial (538 um each), and lateral (323 um) margins.
